Chapter 6 is here 🖤

This is the one where things between Liam and Mai cross a line neither of them can walk back from. I've been excited about this chapter for a while — it's the turning point of the whole story, and everything after it is a different kind of book.

Like the first ones, it's completely free. No paywall, no tier — just read it.

Huge thank you to everyone who's been reading, commenting and sticking around. I'm still very new at this and doing it as a hobby, so honestly every bit of feedback helps me get better. Let me know what you think 🖤

I'd really appreciate it if you'd visit my Patreon page
